reason: The hypothesis directly restates the processing route, mechanism, and outcome of P8 (cryo-rolling + annealing of a CoCrFeNi2.1Nb0.2 HEA to produce a heterogeneous nanostructure with enhanced strength-ductility synergy) and P9/P46 (cryo-rolling + annealing of AlCoCrFeNi2.1 EHEA for hierarchical microstructure and property improvement), merely generalizing it to other dual-phase HEAs and adding claims about Young's modulus and fracture resistance without new mechanistic justification. The core idea is a textbook heterogeneous microstructure strategy applied to a slightly broader material class, making it a copy of existing work.
